scope: Offline source and control-flow review only. No actual Docker, GitHub, network, container or source changes performed by this review.

resolvedFindings.finding: Mutable image tag was not bound to the exact image tested in CI.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Require the saved CI container result to pass correctness and latency checks, validate and compare its image ID to the tag, and run metadata and Trivy by that immutable ID.

resolvedFindings.finding: Nested package metadata command could hide apk or ffmpeg failure.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Use sh -ec with the full unpiped ffmpeg version output.

limits: Trivy uses exit-code 0 to retain all findings. The operator must parse the report and assess every finding before clearance.

Mocks test program guards and command ordering. They do not prove a real successful workflow, image identity, kernel enforcement or scanner database freshness. The actual execution must archive those inputs.
mockSetupCorrections: The first mock attempt used the old system Node. The mock now uses the available Node 22 executable to match the runner.
